gold_sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  -- Stage 1: restrict by a computed condition (reliability + QC + numeric binding threshold)
  SELECT
    apm.measurement_id,
    apm.allele_id,
    apm.peptide_id,
    apm.measurement_value,
    apm.measurement_inequality,
    apm.measurement_type,
    apm.reliability_score,
    apm.quality_control_passed,
    apm.experiment_id,
    apm.lab_id
  FROM allele_peptide_measurements apm
  WHERE apm.quality_control_passed = 1
    AND apm.reliability_score >= (
      SELECT CAST(AVG(reliability_score) AS INTEGER)
      FROM allele_peptide_measurements
      WHERE quality_control_passed = 1
        AND reliability_score IS NOT NULL
    )
    AND apm.measurement_value IS NOT NULL
    AND apm.measurement_type IS NOT NULL
    AND apm.measurement_value <= 5000
),
ranked AS (
  -- Stage 2: rank/aggregate within the restricted set (top peptides per allele by avg value)
  SELECT
    f.allele_id,
    f.peptide_id,
    AVG(f.measurement_value) AS avg_measurement_value,
    COUNT(*) AS measurement_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.allele_id
      ORDER BY AVG(f.measurement_value) ASC, COUNT(*) DESC, f.peptide_id
    ) AS peptide_rank_within_allele
  FROM filtered f
  GROUP BY f.allele_id, f.peptide_id
),
survivors AS (
  -- survivors are those within the per-allele top-N set
  SELECT
    r.allele_id,
    r.peptide_id,
    r.avg_measurement_value,
    r.measurement_count
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE r.peptide_rank_within_allele <= 3
)
-- Stage 3: final figure over survivors (percentage with carefully scoped denominator)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.allele_id) AS allele_count_in_top_peptides,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.peptide_id) AS peptide_count_in_top_peptides,
  AVG(s.avg_measurement_value) AS avg_of_survivors_avg_measurement,
  SUM(s.measurement_count) AS total_measurements_in_survivors,
  100.0 * SUM(
    CASE WHEN s.avg_measurement_value <= 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_survivor_peptides_strong_affinity,
  MIN(src.source_year) AS min_source_year_among_survivors,
  MAX(src.source_year) AS max_source_year_among_survivors
FROM survivors s
JOIN allele_peptide_measurements apm
  ON apm.allele_id = s.allele_id
 AND apm.peptide_id = s.peptide_id
JOIN measurement_sources src
  ON src.source_id = apm.measurement_source_id
JOIN peptides p
  ON p.peptide_id = s.peptide_id

measure: a label assigned by thresholds on a computed quantity
gold_sql:
WITH vis_storage AS (
  SELECT
    dv.vis_id,
    dv.output_id,
    os.location_id,
    os.is_default
  FROM data_visualizations dv
  JOIN digital_outputs d
    ON d.output_id = dv.output_id
  JOIN output_storage os
    ON os.output_id = d.output_id
  WHERE dv.is_active = 1
    AND d.is_public = 1
),
vis_access_stats AS (
  SELECT
    vs.output_id,
    vs.location_id,
    vs.is_default,
    COUNT(*) AS vis_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN al.is_successful = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS success_rate
  FROM vis_storage vs
  LEFT JOIN access_logs al
    ON al.output_id = vs.output_id
   AND al.user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY vs.output_id, vs.location_id, vs.is_default
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    output_id,
    location_id,
    is_default,
    vis_count,
    success_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN success_rate IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
      WHEN success_rate >= 0.95 THEN 'excellent'
      WHEN success_rate >= 0.80 THEN 'good'
      WHEN success_rate >= 0.50 THEN 'fair'
      ELSE 'poor'
    END AS success_band
  FROM vis_access_stats
)
SELECT
  success_band AS headline_success_band,
  COUNT(DISTINCT output_id) AS qualifying_output_count,
  SUM(vis_count) AS total_active_visualizations,
  AVG(success_rate) AS avg_success_rate,
  MIN(success_rate) AS min_success_rate,
  MAX(success_rate) AS max_success_rate
FROM scored
WHERE is_default = 1
GROUP BY success_band
ORDER BY qualifying_output_count DESC, avg_success_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

measure: a change or difference between two periods
gold_sql:
WITH review_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.article_id,
    COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.reviewer_id) AS distinct_reviewers,
    AVG(CASE WHEN r.review_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 END) AS review_date_nonnull_ratio,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_reviews,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_reviews,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'revised' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS revised_reviews,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS accepted_review_rate,
    MAX(r.review_date) AS latest_review_date
  FROM articles a
  LEFT JOIN article_reviews r
    ON r.article_id = a.article_id
  GROUP BY a.article_id
),
period_split AS (
  SELECT
    a.article_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_date >= '2024-01-01' AND r.review_date < '2025-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviews_period_1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_date >= '2025-01-01' AND r.review_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviews_period_2,
    AVG(CASE WHEN r.review_date >= '2024-01-01' AND r.review_date < '2025-01-01' THEN 1.0 ELSE NULL END) AS avg_review_flag_period_1,
    AVG(CASE WHEN r.review_date >= '2025-01-01' AND r.review_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 1.0 ELSE NULL END) AS avg_review_flag_period_2
  FROM articles a
  LEFT JOIN article_reviews r
    ON r.article_id = a.article_id
  GROUP BY a.article_id
),
journal_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    a.article_id,
    j.journal_id,
    j.title AS journal_title,
    a.title AS article_title
  FROM articles a
  JOIN journals j ON j.journal_id = a.journal_id
)
SELECT
  je.journal_title AS journal_title,
  je.article_id AS article_id,
  je.article_title AS article_title,
  (ps.reviews_period_2 - ps.reviews_period_1) AS review_count_change_p2_minus_p1,
  rs.total_reviews AS total_review_count,
  rs.distinct_reviewers AS distinct_reviewer_count,
  rs.accepted_review_rate AS accepted_review_rate,
  rs.latest_review_date AS latest_review_date,
  rs.accepted_reviews AS accepted_review_count,
  rs.rejected_reviews AS rejected_review_count,
  rs.revised_reviews AS revised_review_count,
  (ps.avg_review_flag_period_2 - ps.avg_review_flag_period_1) AS avg_review_flag_change_p2_minus_p1
FROM journal_enriched je
JOIN review_stats rs ON rs.article_id = je.article_id
JOIN period_split ps ON ps.article_id = je.article_id
WHERE rs.total_reviews > 0
ORDER BY review_count_change_p2_minus_p1 DESC, rs.total_reviews DESC
LIMIT 50

measure: a ratio or percentage with a carefully scoped denominator
naive_sql:
SELECT
  p.paper_id AS paper_id,
  p.title AS paper_title,
  COUNT(c.conflict_id) AS conflict_count,
  COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count,
  CAST(COUNT(c.conflict_id) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS conflict_per_review_ratio
FROM papers p
JOIN conflicts_of_interest c
  ON c.paper_id = p.paper_id
JOIN reviews r
  ON r.paper_id = p.paper_id
GROUP BY p.paper_id, p.title
ORDER BY conflict_per_review_ratio DESC, p.paper_id ASC
LIMIT 1
gold_sql:
WITH all_papers AS (
  SELECT p.paper_id, p.title
  FROM papers p
),
paper_review_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.paper_id,
    COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count,
    AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating
  FROM papers p
  LEFT JOIN reviews r
    ON r.paper_id = p.paper_id
  GROUP BY p.paper_id
),
paper_conflict_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.paper_id,
    COUNT(c.conflict_id) AS conflict_count
  FROM papers p
  LEFT JOIN conflicts_of_interest c
    ON c.paper_id = p.paper_id
  GROUP BY p.paper_id
)
SELECT
  prs.paper_id AS paper_id,
  ap.title AS paper_title,
  COALESCE(pcs.conflict_count, 0) AS conflict_count,
  COALESCE(prs.review_count, 0) AS review_count,
  COALESCE(
    CAST(COALESCE(pcs.conflict_count, 0) AS REAL) /
    NULLIF(COALESCE(prs.review_count, 0), 0),
    NULL
  ) AS conflict_per_review_ratio
FROM all_papers ap
JOIN paper_review_stats prs
  ON prs.paper_id = ap.paper_id
LEFT JOIN paper_conflict_stats pcs
  ON pcs.paper_id = ap.paper_id
ORDER BY conflict_per_review_ratio DESC, prs.paper_id ASC
LIMIT 1

measure: an average or median of a per-row quantity
gold_sql:
WITH applicant_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.applicant_id,
    a.career_stage_id,
    a.country_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.application_id) AS application_count
  FROM applicants a
  LEFT JOIN applications ap
    ON ap.applicant_id = a.applicant_id
  GROUP BY a.applicant_id, a.career_stage_id, a.country_id
)
SELECT
  cs.career_stage_name AS career_stage_name,
  c.country_name AS country_name,
  AVG(applicant_stats.application_count) AS avg_applications_per_applicant
FROM applicant_stats
JOIN career_stages cs
  ON cs.career_stage_id = applicant_stats.career_stage_id
JOIN countries c
  ON c.country_id = applicant_stats.country_id
GROUP BY cs.career_stage_name, c.country_name
ORDER BY avg_applications_per_applicant DESC, cs.career_stage_name, c.country_name
LIMIT 10

measure: a per-unit rate (per day, per member, per km)
gold_sql:
WITH access_summary AS (
  SELECT
    ua.user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_access_events,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ua.access_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_access_events
  FROM user_access ua
  GROUP BY ua.user_id
),
user_access_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    total_access_events,
    view_access_events
  FROM access_summary
  WHERE total_access_events > 0
)
SELECT
  e.education_name AS education_name,
  COUNT(*) AS individual_count,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * SUM(uaf.view_access_events) / SUM(uaf.total_access_events),
    6
  ) AS view_access_rate
FROM individuals i
JOIN educations e
  ON e.education_id = i.education_id
JOIN user_access ua
  ON ua.individual_id = i.individual_id
JOIN user_access_filtered uaf
  ON uaf.user_id = ua.user_id
GROUP BY
  e.education_name
ORDER BY view_access_rate DESC, individual_count DESC
LIMIT 10
